video.title: NemoClaw by Nvidia Explained in 60 seconds! Openclaw vs nemoclaw

transcript.text: What is NVIDIA Nemo Guard? So, recently
Open Guard, an AI agent framework,
became the fastest growing open source
project in history. But, enterprises
still blocked it on day one due to
security concerns. Why? Because Open
Guard had no proper sandboxing, no
auditing, and no way to control what an
AI agent could access. In a real
environment, one compromised agent can
take over your entire system. And to
solve this, NVIDIA launched Nemo Guard.
So, Nemo Guard is a security layer that
wraps Open Guard without changing how
agents are built. Using Nemo Guard,
every AI agent now runs in a sandbox
container, and all network access is
blocked by default. You can define
exactly what each agent is allowed to do
using a simple YAML policy file, and the
model is deployed locally on your
infrastructure, so the data never leaves
unless you choose to send it. So, the
idea is simple. Use Open Guard to build
your AI agents, and use Nemo Guard to
run them securely in production.
